items.prompt: After 3 clock cycles, a bit entered at the serial input of an 8-bit shift register is at…
items.explain: Each clock moves the bit one stage to the right; after 3 clocks it is 3 positions from the input, which is stage index 2.

items.prompt: The Verilog expression that shifts in a new serial bit 'si' to the MSB of an 8-bit register q is…
items.explain: Concatenating q[6:0] with si shifts existing bits left and inserts si at bit 0 — a right-shift-in pattern for serial input at LSB. (Invert to shift in at MSB.)

items.prompt: A parallel-in serial-out register with a 'load' signal…
choices: Captures all input bits at once when load is high, then shifts out one bit per clock
Shifts in one bit per clock until full, then outputs all bits in one cycle
Only shifts, never loads in parallel
Requires blocking assignment to work correctly
items.explain: PISO latches the parallel word on the load cycle, then shifts out MSB or LSB first on each subsequent clock.

items.prompt: Using blocking assignment (=) instead of non-blocking (<=) in a clocked shift register produces registered pipeline delay.
items.explain: Blocking assignments update immediately within the always block, causing combinational ripple rather than staged flip-flop delay.
